basic_info.description: Light-filled Central Richmond condominium built in 1999 with 3 bedroom 2 baths all on one level.  Lower unit in a 2 unit condo building.Large living/dining area with wood floors, fireplace and wall of west facing windows with french door leading out to a deck/balcony.  Kitchen with stone counters and new stainless refrigerator. Primary bedroom with en suite bath at the rear of the unit with additional hallway bathroom.  2 private patios, one off the hallway and the other at the rear of the unit.  Shared back yard and one car parking in a side by side garage with additional storage closet and laundry, hookups only, exclusive to the unit in the garage. Convenient location 1 1/2 blocks to Geary Blvd public transit, restaurants and shops and 3 blocks to Golden Gate Park.
